config.direction: every effect reads the richer setting minus the plainer one: multi - single, graph - prose
config.design: all arms in one run per size, so they share each scenario's LLM judge session; the reference arm is re-run here rather than taken from the comparison experiment
config.holm_family: the registered tests: H-D and H-S at each size, H-C per axis

reference_drift.definition: A0 (full pipeline) as run inside this experiment vs A0 as run in the comparison experiment ladder: two separate executions, separate LLM judge sessions, and different scenario counts (test_30 is a 30-scenario stratified subset of test_90). A non-zero delta is expected. It bounds how much of an arm delta could be session effect rather than treatment, and is context for the write-up — never an arm comparison.

token_usage.source: *_trajectory.json metadata (token_usage + execution_time), pooled mean across runs then scenarios; operational metadata only

factorial.definition: The four arms form a complete 2x2 (decomposition x context representation). 'decomposition_effect_given_context_prose' is the multi-agent-minus-single effect when context is prose (no structured injection); 'interaction' is the difference between the two simple effects — a negative interaction means the two mechanisms are SUBSTITUTES (multi-agent decomposition matters less once graph context already carries the structure, or vice versa). Per scenario, mean of runs under zero; each effect is a mean with its BCa bootstrap CI (10000, seed 42), DESCRIPTIVE: the tests are in `registered`.

registered.definition: Registered in docs/guides/benchmark_guides.md §5.5. Main effect of decomposition = mean of (multi - single) under graph and under prose; of substrate = mean of (graph - prose) under multi and under single. H-C = per-scenario effect at the smallest size minus at the largest. Scenario is the unit (mean over runs); failure = 0. Paired Wilcoxon two-sided (exact null), BCa bootstrap CI (10000, seed 42), rank-biserial r; Holm over the tests below that could be run (6 of the 6 registered) at alpha 0.05. Verdict: supported (p_holm < alpha, positive), contrary (p_holm < alpha, negative), else not detected.
